paragraphs.text: Imaryll , referred to as the Elfhame Elite , is a legendary elven warrior from Dominaria .

Imaryll is an elf from the forest of Llanowar on the continent of Aerona , Dominaria. Although there are seven distinct elvish kingdoms (elfhames) in the forest of Llanowar, they are united in their distrust of outsiders. Imaryll is a defender of one of these elfhames, an elite warrior who dual-wields runic scimitars and wears finely crafted leather armor. Which elfhame Imaryll calls home is unknown.
